title_en: Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Agriculture, State Food and Drug Administration: Notice on Further Strengthening the Management of Ephedra Herba and Severely Cracking Down on Illegal Trading of Ephedra Herba and Other Illegal and Criminal Activities
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate

Ministry of Public Security Ministry of Agriculture National Food and Drug Administration

Notice on Further Strengthening the Administration of Ephedra Herb and Severely Crack Down on Illegal Activities Such as Illegal Trading of Ephedra Herb

Gong Tong Zi [2013] No. 16

The Higher People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Public Security Departments (Bureaus), Agriculture (Farming, Animal Husbandry) Departments (Bureaus), Food and Drug Administrations (Drug Administrations) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court and Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; and the People's Procuratorate, Public Security Bureau, and Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

In recent years, as China has continuously strengthened its supervision over ephedrine-based drug precursor chemicals and their compound preparations, criminal activities using such substances to manufacture methamphetamine have been effectively curbed. However, the problem of using ephedra herb to extract ephedrine-based drug precursor chemicals for manufacturing methamphetamine has become increasingly prominent. Ephedra herb has now become another major raw material for the domestic processing and manufacturing of methamphetamine. In 2012, a total of 46 cases nationwide involving the use of ephedra herb to extract ephedrine-based drug precursor chemicals for manufacturing methamphetamine were solved, and 964.4 tons of ephedra herb were seized, representing year-on-year increases of 91.7% and 115.5%, respectively. To further strengthen the administration of ephedra herb and severely crack down on illegal activities such as illegal trading of ephedra herb, in accordance with the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the Circular of the State Council on Prohibiting the Collection and Sale of Facai and Curbing the Indiscriminate Digging of Licorice and Ephedra Herb (Guo Fa [2000] No. 13), and other relevant provisions, the relevant requirements are hereby notified as follows:

1. Strictly Implement the Licensing System for the Collection and Purchase of Ephedra Herb

The collection and purchase of ephedra herb shall be subject to a strict licensing system. Without a license, no unit or individual may collect or purchase ephedra herb. Units purchasing ephedra herb may only sell it to pharmaceutical manufacturing enterprises. The competent departments of agriculture and animal husbandry shall strictly issue collection permits for ephedra herb, make overall determinations of the collection volume in various regions, prohibit any unit or individual from digging ephedra herb without a permit, strictly supervise that units and individuals digging ephedra herb sell it only by presenting the collection permit, strictly control the collection volume of ephedra herb, and strictly prohibit digging ephedra herb without a permit or in excess of the permitted volume. The food and drug regulatory departments shall urge relevant pharmaceutical manufacturing enterprises to establish and improve the pharmaceutical quality management system strictly in accordance with the Good Manufacturing Practice for Pharmaceutical Products (2010 Revision), and in particular, to establish ledgers for the purchase of ephedra herb, product processing, and sales, and to retain them for two years for reference.

2. Effectively Strengthen Supervision and Inspection of the Digging, Trading, and Transportation of Ephedra Herb

The competent departments of agriculture and animal husbandry shall carefully investigate the distribution and reserves of ephedra herb resources, strengthen supervision over ephedra herb resources, and seriously investigate and punish illegal digging of ephedra herb and the forgery, resale, or transfer of collection permits. Once such acts are discovered, they shall be punished at the maximum penalty. The food and drug regulatory departments shall strengthen supervision and inspection of pharmaceutical manufacturing and trading enterprises, and shall deal with violations of the Drug Administration Law and related provisions in the production or trading of ephedra herb and its products in accordance with the law. The public security organs shall, in conjunction with the competent departments of agriculture and animal husbandry, strengthen inspections of the transportation of ephedra herb, deploy forces for inspection and seizure on key highways and at provincial entry and exit points, and shall, for any transportation of ephedra herb without a collection permit or purchase permit, or where the lawful purpose cannot be explained, detain and investigate it in accordance with the law.

3. Investigate and Punish Criminal Acts Such as Illegal Digging and Trading of Ephedra Herb in Accordance with the Law

People's courts, people's procuratorates, and public security organs in all localities shall investigate and punish criminal acts such as illegal digging and trading of ephedra herb in accordance with the law, and shall impose punishments in light of the specific circumstances as follows:

(1) Where ephedra herb is dug or purchased for the purpose of manufacturing drugs, the offender shall be convicted and punished for the crime of manufacturing drugs in accordance with Article 347 of the Criminal Law.

(2) Where ephedra herb is dug or purchased for the purpose of smuggling or illegally trading ephedrine-based drug precursor chemicals after extraction, and the quantity of ephedrine-based drug precursor chemicals contained in the ephedra herb involved reaches the corresponding threshold for conviction, the offender shall be convicted and punished for the crime of smuggling drug precursor chemicals or the crime of illegally trading drug precursor chemicals, respectively, in accordance with Article 350, Paragraphs 1 and 3 of the Criminal Law.

(3) Where a person, knowing that others are manufacturing drugs or smuggling or illegally trading drug precursor chemicals, provides them with ephedra herb or provides assistance such as transporting or storing ephedra herb, that person shall be punished as an accomplice to the crime of manufacturing drugs, the crime of smuggling drug precursor chemicals, or the crime of illegally trading drug precursor chemicals, respectively.

(4) Where ephedra herb is dug, sold, or purchased in violation of state regulations, and there is no evidence that the purpose was to manufacture drugs or smuggle or illegally trade drug precursor chemicals, if the conduct constitutes a crime under Article 225 of the Criminal Law, the offender shall be convicted and punished for the crime of illegal business operations.

(5) Where any of the above acts is committed and the offender is convicted and punished for the crime of manufacturing drugs, the crime of smuggling drug precursor chemicals, or the crime of illegally trading drug precursor chemicals, the quantity of drug precursor chemicals involved shall be calculated based on the conversion ratio of 300 kilograms of ephedra herb to 1 kilogram of ephedrine. Where the offender is convicted and punished for the crime of manufacturing drugs, regardless of the quantity of ephedra herb involved, criminal liability shall be pursued.

May 21, 2013
